validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml"
       xmlns:event="https://github.com/stateforward/scxml.rs/namespaces/event"
       version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="idle">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="orderSchema" expr="({type: 'object'})"/>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="idle">
    <transition event="order" target="done"
                event:schema='{"type": "object"}' event:schemaexpr="orderSchema"/>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

primary.message: a second schema for the same event data

notes: as with SCXML's other attribute/`expr` pairs, an element gives its schema either literally (`event:schema`) or as an expression (`event:schemaexpr`), not both
diagnostics.help: keep one of the two attributes
